name: City Council Special Meeting - Closed Session
agenda_text:
RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Special Meeting of the City Council – CLOSED SESSION
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive

  MONDAY, FEBRUARY 6, 2023 – 5:00 p.m.
 Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, City Council members and staff will be participating in
  this meeting via teleconference pursuant to Government Code Section 54953(e).

  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
  The public may only join this meeting virtually. For Special Meetings, public
 communications are limited to agenda items. Once public comments are heard, the Closed
  Session will begin, and the virtual meeting will be locked to unauthorized persons.

 Written comments may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83691718366
  Webinar ID: 836 9171 8366
  One tap mobile:
  +16694449171,,83691718366# or +16699009128,,83691718366#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 or +1 669 900 9128 or +1 346 248 7799 or +1 719 359 4580

 Teleconference participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor.

  In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services,
  please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
  distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for public
  inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business hours and
  posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 5:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Halpern, McSweeney, Honig, Mayor Pro Tem
  Davis, Mayor Pearl

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Public comments on Closed Session Items only – may be
submitted electronically prior to the closed session starting. Members of the public may offer
comment telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed
on Page 1 of this agenda. Live comments will be limited to three minutes. Refer to Page 1 of the Agenda
on how to submit your Public Comments electronically or how to provide Live Public Comments.

CLOSED SESSION:

1.  Conference with Legal Counsel – Anticipated Litigation
  Initiation of Litigation (California Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(4)):
  1 potential case

2.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR
  (California Government Code Section 54956.8)
  Property: Portion of Lot 14, Tract No. 43744
  Agency negotiator: City Manager Rob de Geus
  Negotiating party: Agoura and Lindero Associates LLC.
  Under negotiation: price and terms of payment

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Friday, February 3, 2023 at 4:30 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas or
 www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the new Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a central
 location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your notifications. Sign up using
 “Notify Me” https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx

 If any additional items are distributed to City Council less than 72 hours prior to the meeting, they are
 available in City Hall during normal business hours and posted on the City’s Website -
 https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets
